_purpose: Reference template for what a real Gmail ingestion event looks like end to end -- raw provider payload, then the canonical EventEnvelope it normalizes into (see modules/ingestion/envelope/schemas.py), then the decision record a golden-set example is built from. Same purpose as slack_event_template.json: ground the golden dataset's synthetic examples against a realistic source payload instead of an arbitrary guess.

raw_provider_payload._comment: Gmail API users.messages.get response shape, trimmed to the fields Locus actually uses. threadId groups a reply chain the same way Slack's thread_ts does.
raw_provider_payload.snippet: Confirming: background check vendor stays as Checkr for the SOC2 renewal cycle, no change from last year's vendor review.

headers.name: Subject
headers.value: Re: SOC2 renewal -- background check vendor

body.data: Confirming: background check vendor stays as Checkr for the SOC2 renewal cycle, no change from last year's vendor review.

normalized_event_envelope._comment: What normalizer.py should produce from the payload above, matching modules/ingestion/envelope/schemas.py::EventEnvelope exactly.
normalized_event_envelope.raw_content: Confirming: background check vendor stays as Checkr for the SOC2 renewal cycle, no change from last year's vendor review.

real_permalink_format._comment: Gmail's actual web permalink format -- what source_permalink should look like once ingestion is real.

resulting_decision_record._comment: Illustrative decision this thread would produce. Note this is the OPPOSITE case from the Slack template: this is exactly the kind of real decision that ge-075 (the negative/background-check example) deliberately does NOT include in its tenant's candidate pool, to test that the pipeline doesn't fabricate an answer when no matching decision exists for that specific tenant.
resulting_decision_record.decision_statement: Retain Checkr as the background check vendor for the SOC2 renewal cycle.
resulting_decision_record.rationale: No change from last year's vendor review; renewal cycle does not require re-evaluating vendors.
